# ProfilePicture

**Class:** `UltraCanvasProfilePicture` · **Group:** [Pickers, dialogs and feedback](../Groups/Pickers-dialogs-and-feedback.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasProfilePicture.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasProfilePicture.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasProfilePicture.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A person's profile picture: a square picture in a circle or the initials on a colour their id picks; editable, it chooses a picture, places it in a crop dialog (drag, zoom) and writes the square; the profile page's row with Choose / Change and Remove; the cropper on its own

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasProfilePicture> CreateProfilePicture(const std::string& identifier, float diameter = 96);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasProfilePictureEditor> CreateProfilePictureEditor(const std::string& identifier, float width = 440);
UCElementDescriptor MakeProfilePictureDescriptor();
UCElementDescriptor MakeProfilePictureEditorDescriptor();
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasProfilePicture(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasProfilePicture(const std::string& identifier, float diameter);
explicit UltraCanvasProfilePicture(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onPictureChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::string& path)> onPictureChanged` | A new picture written (its path), or "" when it was removed. |
| `onPictureError` | `std::function<void(const std::string& error)> onPictureError` | Writing the chosen picture failed (why). |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Options and setters

Everything that configures the element: appearance, behaviour and content.

| Member | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `SetPicturePath` | `void SetPicturePath(const std::string& path)` | A picture file (UTF-8), shown whole in the circle when it is square, its middle square otherwise; "" for none. No callback. |
| `SetPictureFrame` | `void SetPictureFrame(const std::string& sourcePath, const ProfilePictureFrame& frame)` | A square of a picture, not yet written: what the crop dialog's previews show. SetPicturePath clears it. |
| `SetName` | `void SetName(const std::string& name)` | The name the initials come from and its accessible name. |
| `SetColorKey` | `void SetColorKey(const std::string& key)` | What picks the initials' colour (a person's id); "" uses the name. |
| `SetEditable` | `void SetEditable(bool editable)` | Editable: the badge, the hand pointer, and a click (or Return / Space with the focus) opens ChoosePicture. Off by default. |
| `SetOutputDirectory` | `void SetOutputDirectory(const std::string& directory)` | Where chosen pictures are written: a folder of the application's own. Default: "ultracanvas-profile-pictures" in the temporary folder. |
| `SetOutputSize` | `void SetOutputSize(int pixels)` | The side of a picture written, in pixels (64 to 1024; 256 by default). |
| `SetMaxOutputBytes` | `void SetMaxOutputBytes(size_t bytes)` | The largest file a chosen picture may be, in bytes (0, the default: any): it is written smaller until it fits (CropProfilePictureWithin). |
| `RemovePicture` | `void RemovePicture()` | Back to the initials; onPictureChanged(""). |
| `SetStyle` | `void SetStyle(const ProfilePictureStyle& style)` |  |

## Option types in this header

### struct `ProfilePictureFrame`

Which square of a picture is shown: its centre as a fraction of the picture's width and height (0.5, 0.5 is the middle), and the zoom - 1 is the largest square that fits the picture (its shorter side), 2 a square half as wide. Clamped so the square never leaves the picture.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `centerX` | `double centerX = 0.5` |  |
| `centerY` | `double centerY = 0.5` |  |
| `zoom` | `double zoom = 1.0` |  |

Methods: `SquareIn`, `Clamped`
